preExecutionActions.fact: At mapping time phase20-browser, phase21-browser and phase22-runtime hard-code old cluster 7701548153213487841. Preserve ownership checks; bind the actual current owned manifest/cluster before execution.
Historical output/snapshot prefixes are restricted to phase-21 / phase-23. Use isolated current-phase wrappers or reviewed explicit current-phase prefixes; never overwrite historical reports.
Identity protocol regressions use handwritten schema and mocked intent/selection ports. Run current canonical install plus actual HTTPS; do not promote these tests to canonical evidence.
Explicit gaps: human auth_time, wrong ID Token audience, plain/malformed PKCE, same-context tabs, actual micro-app/notification synchronization, keyboard/focus/Cookie restrictions, clock skew.

Identity recovery runtime is shared identity/platform + portal + RP. It does not automatically fresh-install or restore stores/work-orders/notification. Bind those schemas/binaries and actual API/socket paths separately. SDK is an artifact, not another app container.
Matrix work created no runtime resource. Environment owner must produce current-phase complete cleanup/disk evidence; shared retained resources need an explicit active owner and future cleanup scope.
